originals.idea: place spawns in a distance band from the player, outside view, with a ground probe and overlap check

originals.name: Attract call cadence
originals.idea: ambient call within a radius on a random delay of 3-9 s, mostly a call and sometimes a step sound, dampened when blocked

defects: HP per level-up seeded from render frame count (FormulaHelper.cs line 348). Fix: take the roll from the server random source and record it.
Foe spawn placement has no attempt cap (FoeSpawner.cs lines 119-200, retried each frame from line 76). Fix: cap tries per spawn, then widen the band or give up with a log.
Dungeon light polls at 0.4 s (DungeonLightHandler.cs line 26), so lights pop in up to 0.4 s late. Fix: check on player cell change or a shorter poll.

Material bucket sum is 259 but the roll is clamped to 256 (ItemBuilder.cs line 42; RandomMaterial in FormulaHelper.cs). The last bucket is reachable only at the top two values. Check it is intended; if not, make the sum 256.
